messages:
nightdash: [ALERT] Nightly perf dashboard detected a p99 latency spike for 'stream' model group: +12% vs baseline (120ms -> 135ms) between 01:40-02:10 UTC. dashboard: https://nightdash.internal/redwood/streams/stream-group

mira: saw this in the morning. spike looks concentrated, not global.

jon: is this only on dedicated pools or also hosted? any region info?

lee: breaking down by pool: dedicated-us-west-2-gpu with kernel-prober flag ON shows the spike. hosted nodes in the same region are fine. attaching quick heatmap.

sahil: did a light profile on one repro host: pprof flame shows heavy time in kernel_selection::probe_path and a lot of calls to fallback_kernel(). The fallback kernel is ~3-4x slower for long sequences.

mira: we merged adaptive-kernel-prober yesterday (PR d4c5e6 / #1892). could be related.

deploy-bot: CI/nightly: perf-suite/stream-model-group failed - p99 increased >10% on linux-x86-rtg (job 9843). logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/9843

jon: can we bisect the last 24h merges? @nina can you run perf-bisect on the canary config (seq 1536)? bisect script: infra/tools/bisect_perf.sh

nina: starting bisect now with: ./infra/tools/bisect_perf.sh --range HEAD~24 --test stream-p99 --seq 1536 --batching smart --kernel-prober=on

nina: bisect finished: regression introduced at commit b3f1a2e (merge of PR #1892 - adaptive-kernel-prober). reverting that commit locally brings p99 back to baseline in my repro.

sahil: dug into the prober logs: probe_timeout path triggers when probe_latency > 15ms and then we call a conservative fallback kernel. The prober's probing RPC adds ~18-22ms under contention which flips the decision. For short seqs it's fine; long seqs (>=1024) + kv_cache miss_ratio > 0.2 hit the slow path.

lee: repro matrix shows: seq_len ≥ 1536, batch_size ≤ 4, kv-cache cold start -> high miss ratio. Only the prober-enabled nodes show this pattern.

mira: immediate mitigation: reduce kernel_prober.probe_timeout_ms from 20 -> 2 for canary nodes and pause rollout. That should avoid probe RPC adding latency.

jon: create a revert PR for b3f1a2e and hold the rollout. Also we should add an integration perf test for long-seq + high-kv-miss to catch this earlier.

mira: PR #1899 opened: revert adaptive-kernel-prober, and flagged as rollback candidate. https://git.internal/r/redwood/pr/1899

deploy-bot: Rollout rc-2026-03-17 paused by mira. Reason: manual hold due to perf regression.

nina: follow-ups I'm taking: 1) land revert PR 1899 (in progress), 2) add nightly perf case: seq=1536 + kv_miss_sim=true to perf-suite, 3) add telemetry to kernel_prober to record probe_latency and decision reasons. Filing tickets now.

sahil: i'll prepare a root-cause doc with traces, pprof snapshots (before/after), and suggested prober fix: make probe async and use sample-based scoring rather than live probe under high contention.

lee: infra note: we'll push the probe_timeout override to canary nodes via rollout-ops within 15m.

mira: assignments: nina -> finish revert & tests, sahil -> RCA + telemetry schema, lee -> rollout config change, jon -> review revert PR. Target: revert merged & canaries back to baseline within 30 minutes. If that succeeds, unpause and re-evaluate prober changes behind a feature flag + more tests.

jon: thanks all. keep updates in this thread and paste perf graphs when you have them. :thumbsup:
